population: retain previous qualified332 unless independent audit demonstrates exclusion; assess new dates by identity-only inventory; no expansion based on scores
exposure: all previous177 evaluated races are now development, no pristine holdout is claimed

stages.question: Are identity, timing, protection and scoring sound?
stages.budget: metadata/hash/source audit and synthetic regressions; no fits

stages.question: Which plausible pre-race feature groups add beyond market plus form?
stages.budget: at most24 fixed groups/additions/removals per outer fold, at most6 inner fits each; 180CPU seconds

stages.question: Does validation select a stable penalty/strength or justified interaction?
stages.budget: best3 group recipes per outer fold; L2 {0.1,0.3,1,3}; strength{0.25,0.5,1}; at most216 additional fits, 300CPU seconds

stages.question: Can limited nonlinear structure or out-of-sample blending help?
stages.budget: up to6 fixed tree configurations per outer fold, at most3 inner folds, 120CPU seconds; validation-only blend grid

stages.question: Does the full selection procedure survive later chronological blocks?
stages.budget: at most3 predeclared selector families plus market/frozen anchors; all decisions from earlier validation only; one outer scoring pass after all selections frozen

stages.question: Do gains or selections survive date/venue/odds stability and dependence?
stages.budget: 3000 date-block paired/max-statistic bootstrap, leave-one-date-out, fixed nearby thresholds; <=60CPU seconds

stopping: complete these distinct stages; do not add combinations in response to outer metrics. Stop expansion if no stable advantage or sample cannot distinguish. Any revised budget recorded before that stage runs.
returns: Only if actionable quote/deduction evidence is qualified; otherwise no financial estimates.
compute: single BLAS/OMP thread, nice10, recheck host load before fits
